name: OpenRabbit Team Rules
description: Custom static analysis rules and architectural policies for code review (Schema v1)

rules.title: Avoid raw console.log in production modules
rules.description: Direct console.log statements pollute standard output and can leak sensitive payload data. Use the structured logger (logger.info or logger.debug) instead.
rules.author: OpenRabbit Community

rules.title: Insecure plaintext HTTP URL in service communication
rules.description: Transmitting data over unencrypted HTTP exposes credentials and traffic to man-in-the-middle (MITM) interception. Enforce HTTPS for remote endpoints.

rules.title: Blocking synchronous readFileSync call in async execution path
rules.description: Synchronous filesystem methods (readFileSync) block Node.js event loop threads, hurting server throughput and scalability. Prefer fs.promises.readFile or asynchronous counterparts.

rules.title: Blocking synchronous writeFileSync call in async execution path
rules.description: Synchronous filesystem methods (writeFileSync) block Node.js event loop threads, hurting server throughput and scalability. Prefer fs.promises.writeFile or asynchronous counterparts.

rules.title: Blocking synchronous existsSync call in async execution path
rules.description: Synchronous filesystem methods (existsSync) block Node.js event loop threads, hurting server throughput and scalability. Restructure to attempt the async operation and handle ENOENT, or use fs.promises.access where a pre-check is unavoidable.
